title: A power series ring over a Noetherian normal domain is a Noetherian normal domain
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], and let $R[[x]]$ be the ring of formal power series in one variable $x$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] (the case $n=1$). Then $R[[x]]$ is a Noetherian normal domain: it is Noetherian, an integral domain, and every element of its fraction field which is a root of a monic polynomial with coefficients in $R[[x]]$ lies in $R[[x]]$.
